app.name: GitRepoFlow
app.description: GitRepoFlow analyzes any public GitHub repository — its file tree, package manifests, container/infrastructure files and GitHub Actions workflows — and renders the detected architecture as an interactive 3D isometric diagram that can be exported as FossFLOW JSON, SVG or PNG.

ai.note: provider: auto | lovable | openai | anthropic | google | groq | openrouter | compatible | none. API keys are read from server environment variables only and are never exposed to the browser.
